body.statement:
Along the explicit path \(n_\ell=2\ell\) and \(m_\ell=2\lceil\gamma\ell\rceil\), and in the nonempty fixed-complexity regime where Theorem \(\mathrm{thm:adaptive\mbox{-}minimax\mbox{-}lower}\) applies, write
\[
 R^\star_\ell=
 \inf_{\widetilde U\in\mathfrak E_{n_\ell,m_\ell}}
 \sup_{P\in\mathfrak P^{\mathrm{pred}}_{n_\ell,m_\ell}(r,\mu,K,q,B,\lambda)}
 E_P[\mathcal L(\widetilde U,U)].
\]
Determine the minimax rate inside the proved \(b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\)-to-constant bracket: decide whether \(R^\star_\ell\) is of order \(b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\), of constant order, or at an intermediate rate, by either constructing a sharper observed-data estimator or proving an estimator-independent converse.  Only in a regime where \(R^\star_\ell\asymp b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\) should one determine \(C_\star\), ask whether recorded IPW--SVD attains it, and characterize whether a nonconstant predictable propensity path is least favorable.

obligation.what_is_open: Close the observed-data minimax gap between the lower/reference scale \(b_{nm}\) and the constant hybrid upper endpoint, before attempting a sharp \(b_{nm}\)-normalized constant.
obligation.obstruction: The fixed-propensity Fano family gives only a positive multiple of \(b_{nm}\); the sine fallback gives only constant risk; and the adaptive endogenous-factor witness lower-bounds only recorded IPW--SVD, not every estimator in the observed-data class.
obligation.attempted: A row-local constant-propensity packing, matrix-Freedman IPW control, and the deterministic incoherent sine fallback have all been completed.  They give a valid two-sided bracket but do not reveal the information retained by an estimator that is robust to outcome-dependent future singular factors.
obligation.partial_result: In the lower-bound regime, \(c b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\le R^\star_\ell\le C\).  Nonemptiness forces \(\lambda_{nm}\le2B\sqrt{nm}\); at fixed \(r,\mu,K,q\) and bounded aspect ratio this yields \(b_{nm}\gtrsim\sqrt{\log n/n}\), whereas both \(a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}\) and the blind resolution \(d_{nm}\) are at least order \(\sqrt{\log n}\).  Recorded IPW--SVD can fail at the \(b_{nm}\) scale, but this does not determine the minimax rate or \(C_\star\).

body.justification: A sharp \(b_{nm}\)-normalized constant is meaningful only after determining whether the minimax risk is of order \(b_{nm}\), constant order, or intermediate.
body.gap: Construct a sharper observed-data estimator or an estimator-independent converse without adding exogeneity or singular-factor predictability.
body.consumer: Resolution would determine the attainable decision-budget and signal-strength law before any sharp-constant calculation.
